parole.significato: Any of several breeds of dogs used as sled dogs.
parole.testo: Shortening of husky dog, where husky is ultimately from the same Old Montagnais root as Eskimo.

From Montagnais Innu, from inniw (“man”), from Proto-Algonquian *erenyiwa. Not related to Inuit. This replaced the term Montagnais as the primary name of the people since 1990, but it remains in use officially to refer to its subgroups.

parole.significato: A member of an Algonquian First People from northeastern North America, mainly Maine and Quebec.
